plugin.name: wsync
plugin._long: Keep every output on the same workspace. When any output changes workspace by any mechanism (edge flipping, expo selection, vswitch, grid, or a raw IPC request), all other outputs are driven to the same viewport, so independent workspace sets move in lockstep. Disable to let outputs hold different workspaces, for example during a presentation.

option.name: enabled
option._long: Mirror every output's workspace changes onto all other outputs. Set false to let outputs move independently (re-attaches live when set true again).

option.name: debug_log
option._long: Log workspace-sync mirror operations to journal.
